run: GHZ-style 3-qubit phase probe on superconducting cloud quantum hardware
counts_note: Result file contained 1152 byte-records; the 3 measured bits are the low bits of each. Several records carry extra high bits (stray values from the raw bit-array export), so the distribution below uses the low 3 bits and should be treated as approximate until re-exported with the Qiskit BitArray API.
caveat: Single hardware run, uncorrected for readout error. GHZ-population above ~0.5 shows entanglement-like correlation but is not a fidelity measurement.
redacted: Hardware provider, backend name, job id and account identifiers withheld.
